How do 3-Way Light Switches Work? Also, let's look at 4-Way Switches, and Basic Light Switches!
Take a look at their PCB Assembly, for an inexpensive population of the components on your PCBs.
We use light switches every day, and yet have you ever seen the inside of one? In this video we open up 3 types of light switches: the basic light switch, 3-Way light switches, and 4-Way light switches. We also explore how they can be wired together to turn on one or multiple lights.
